The M4 owns the workspace and Cline tool loop. M5 is a control plane only:
tailnet HTTPS terminates at its loopback travel LiteLLM on :7411. Select
local-qwen38 for normal work, local-coder as its compatibility coding alias, and
harness-orch only for explicit multi-model orchestration. No paid model is
listed and there is no automatic paid fallback.

Emergency direct-Qwen mode is deliberate and manual:

  python3 scripts/configure_cline.py --direct

It points only to http://100.68.133.1:8888/v1 with model
qwen38-flash-next-nvfp4-sglang and never activates automatically.
